subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given words.**

 

A person who compiles dictionaries
solution:
The correct answer is **Lexicographer**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• 
 The most appropriate word is Lexicographer.
 
 
• 
 It means a person whose job is to write dictionaries. (एक व्यक्ति जिसका काम शब्दकोश लिखना है।)

 
 
• 
 **​For example,** He also works as a translator and lexicographer.
 
 
 
 
• 
 Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct option is **2**.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• 
 ​Let's look at the meanings of the other words:

 **Meaning**

 study of the techniques of secret writing. (गुप्त लेखन की तकनीकों का अध्ययन।)
